"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Philippine President Rodrigo Duterte’s “War on Drugs” and other anti-people campaigns have taken the lives of over 29,000 urban poor, peasants, workers, indigenous and environmental activists as well as human rights defenders, religious leaders, and peace advocates.",

"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"As of November 2018, over 70,000 victims of threats and harassments have occurred in the Philippines.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"As of November 2018, nearly half a million internal refugees exist in the Philippines.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"More than 16 mayors and vice mayors have been killed since President Duterte took office.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Duterte publicly advocated the killing of Catholic bishops in press conferences.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Three Catholic priests were assassinated during a period in which Duterte publicly advocated the killing of Catholic bishops.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Union and labor leaders have been among those attacked by the administration.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"30 labor leaders have been killed.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"3 labor leaders are being held as political prisoners.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"More than 200 notices of strikes have taken place under Duterte’s administration.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"The Philippine National Police violently dispersed many strikes.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
